description: This file defines an enumeration ResponseType representing different response types (error, nack, response) used in request handling within the project. It includes methods to retrieve a ResponseType from a name, and implements CharSequence.

classes.name: ResponseType
classes.description: An enumeration of different response types for a request, including ERROR, NACK, and RESPONSE, with methods to facilitate conversion and string representation.

methods.name: fromName
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the corresponding ResponseType enum based on a string name.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name string associated with this ResponseType.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the name string.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at a specified index within the name string.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the name string between start and end indices.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the name string representation of this ResponseType.
